# backtogreen

> A Claude Code Stop hook. When CI fails on your pull request, the session that opened it is told and fixes it.

When a turn ends, the hook lists the branches checked out in the repo's worktrees, makes one `gh pr list --author @me` call, and matches branches to your open PRs. If a check failed, it answers Claude with the failing check names so the session finds the cause, fixes it and pushes. Each (PR, commit, failing set) is reported once.

Needs python3 and the GitHub CLI (`gh auth login`). Open a new Claude Code session after installing.

## Install

    git clone https://github.com/flisk-sh/failedci2claude && cd failedci2claude && ./install.sh
